title: Pentagon PURSUE Launches: 162 Declassified UAP Files Released at war.gov/UFO
detail: The Department of War launches the PURSUE program (Presidential Unsealing and Reporting System for UAP Encounters) at war.gov/UFO, releasing the first tranche of 162 declassified files — 120 PDF documents, 28 videos, and 14 images — sourced from the FBI (56), DoD (82), NASA (12), and State Department (8). Key contents include: 1969 Apollo 11 crew debriefing in which Buzz Aldrin describes a 'sizeable' unexplained object near the moon and unexplained 'little flashes inside the cabin spaced a couple of minutes apart'; Apollo 12 and 17 astronaut reports; 2024 infrared footage of a football-shaped UAP near Japan; military memos from Iraq (2022) and Syria (2024); and State Department diplomatic cables from Papua New Guinea, Kazakhstan, Turkmenistan, Georgia, and Mexico. The official statement explicitly states the files show 'no indication that the U.S. government has had any interaction with beings from other planets,' and invites the public to 'make up their own minds.' The War Zone characterized the release as historically interesting but leaving observers 'shrugging.' Notably, the 46 specific videos demanded by Rep. Luna in March 2026 were NOT included — Luna confirmed they are expected in Tranche 2 'within 30 days.' Rolling releases are planned every 'few weeks.'
confidenceReason: Official DoW press release + confirmed by 9+ major outlets including NBC, NPR, CNN, Al Jazeera, ABC, PBS, Stars and Stripes.

title: Greer 25th Anniversary Disclosure Event: Army Green Beret Testifies on Indiana Non-Human Artifact Facility
detail: Dr. Steven Greer holds a press conference at the National Press Club in Washington D.C. marking the 25th anniversary of his 2001 Disclosure Project event. Key testimony: a U.S. Army Green Beret testified he was taken to a facility in Indiana housing non-human artifacts, and separately witnessed what he described as a man-made reverse-engineered 'Tic Tac' craft during a covert mission in the Middle East. Greer's framing positions the Tic Tac as human-built through reverse engineering, not extraterrestrial. New photographic and video evidence was presented. Greer delivered policy recommendations for Presidential executive actions and Congressional oversight. EDITORIAL NOTE: Greer's events historically present unverified claims from anonymous witnesses. Testimony has not been independently corroborated by government sources. Included as institutional disclosure record, not verified fact.
confidenceReason: Event confirmed at National Press Club. Green Beret testimony is unverified whistleblower claim; not independently corroborated by government.
